title: Heavenly Secrets First Appear
next_chapter_hook: When that will that transcends heaven and earth branded a mocking laughter into Chen Ji's mind, he finally understood—that he, this chess piece, might never truly have entered the game.

text.content:
The Tianqing Sect's grand sacrificial ceremony was to be held at the Tianxuan Platform before the Sect's Sacred Hall.

Before the first rays of dawn could fully pierce through the sea of clouds, the area around the Tianxuan Platform was already teeming with people. Three thousand six hundred disciples, clad in plain white sacrificial robes, resembled neatly arranged white pieces on a chessboard, forming an impenetrable wall around the elevated platform. Incense curled through the air, Buddhist chants hummed softly—solemn to the point of oppression.

Chen Ji stood at the very back of the crowd, his Servant Disciple's gray robe conspicuously jarring amid the surrounding white glow. He gazed downward, appearing no different from those trembling servants around him—yet his divine consciousness spread like spider silk, silently enveloping the entire Tianxuan Platform under his control.

dialogue.content:
"Waste of space, today's sun is particularly blinding, wouldn't you say?"

A resonant voice came from the side. Han Lie had somehow approached Chen Ji's flank, his Xuanwu Sect armor gleaming with dark golden light in the morning sun. He tilted his head slightly, the smirk at his lips several degrees more pronounced than during yesterday's rehearsal.

Chen Ji raised his eyes, calmly meeting those tiger-like gazes. He saw the suppressed killing intent deep within Han Lie's eyes—that accumulated resentment from being repeatedly bested by a waste of space, seemingly finally finding an outlet today.

text.content:
Chen Ji offered no reply, merely sidestepping slightly, yielding half a step of distance.

This yielding, in Han Lie's eyes, was undoubtedly cowardice. He snorted coldly, striding toward the front-row seats with great steps, leaving behind a meaningful remark: "We'll meet again on the Tianxuan Platform later. I hope that useless shell of yours can hold together until the ceremony ends."

The crowd suddenly fell silent.

At the very center of the Tianxuan Platform, that sacrificial Heaven Vessel sealed for a hundred years suddenly emitted a low humming sound. The ancient inscriptions carved on the vessel's surface began to glow with a faint blue light, like a slumbering giant slowly opening its eyes.

"Heavenly Vessel anomaly! Quickly, report to the Sect Master!"

A Law Enforcement Elder cried out in alarm, his voice trembling slightly with shock. The surrounding disciples all retreated in panic, staring fearfully at that ancient vessel radiating ghostly light. Only Chen Ji remained unmoved where he stood, a burning sensation spreading across his chest—that was the Tianji Record Fragment vibrating frantically.

Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, carrying an unprecedented gravity: "Boy, it's sensed you. That's the tendril of Heavenly Dao, searching for you."

dialogue.content:
"What's there to panic about!"

An aged yet commanding voice drifted from the mist behind the elevated platform. Ling Yuan, draped in dark、法袍, descended slowly through the void. His gaze swept across the entire gathering before settling on that trembling sacrificial vessel, a flicker of indescribable light passing through his eyes.

"The ancient records state, 'When Heavenly Secrets appear, great events must follow.' This is both the warning left by our ancestors and the opportunity for our Tianqing Sect." The old Sect Master's voice reverberated across the plaza, "Issue the command—the ceremony begins immediately."

text.content:
The ceremonial rites officially commenced.

Three hundred Inner Disciples simultaneously formed incantation gestures, channeling heavenly Spiritual Energy into the sacrificial vessel. The ghostly blue light grew increasingly bright, the inscriptions on the vessel began moving like living things, weaving an intricate formation pattern through the air.

Chen Ji felt the heat at his chest had burned through to his flesh. The Tianji Record Fragment struggled wildly within him, as if trying to break free and answer the call emanating from the Tianxuan Platform.

He gritted his teeth, attempting to suppress it, yet discovered the vibrations only intensified day by day—as if something was watching him through this invisible tether.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, wrapping his divine consciousness around the fragment at his chest, murmuring softly: "Endure it. It's not yet time."

However, the moment his voice faded, an unprecedented oppressive force suddenly exploded from the center of the Tianxuan Platform.

The ghostly light of the sacrificial vessel transformed in an instant to an ink-black color. A massive eye凝聚ed above the vessel's mouth, its pupil a bottomless chaos, as if the entire heavens and earth were merely floating specks within its gaze.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao.

It was not a legendary symbol, but genuinely, with supreme might, descended upon the Tianqing Sect's ceremony.

text.content:
The entire Tianxuan Platform fell into deathly silence.

Three thousand six hundred disciples knelt to the ground simultaneously, trembling too violently to lift their heads. Only a handful of highly cultivated elders could barely support their bodies, yet none dared meet that eye's gaze.

Ling Yuan's expression at this moment became extraordinarily complex—he clearly had not anticipated this scene. But quickly, a greedy light flickered through his eyes as he declared loudly: "Heavenly Dao's favor! This is Heavenly Dao's favor upon our Tianqing Sect! Quickly, bow in gratitude for Heavenly Grace!"

Yet that eye paid no attention to his words. Its pupil slowly turned, passing over the kneeling masses, passing over the terrified elders—finally—locking onto Chen Ji.

Chen Ji felt an invisible force lock onto him.

It was an irresistible scrutiny, as if a deity examining an ant. His limbs and organs at this moment seemed frozen solid, even his blood ceasing to flow. The Tianji Record Fragment within him emitted a sharp wail, the two forces engaging in a silent tug-of-war using him as the conduit.

"Chen Ji..."

A voice resounded directly within his mind. Not Mo Xiansheng's aged tone, not Chen Nian's childish voice, but a cold timbre transcending gender, transcending age, as if heaven and earth itself were speaking.

"Found you."

dialogue.content:
"Buzz—"

Chen Ji felt an intense pain surge through his mind. A resonance formed between the Tianji Record Fragment and the Eye of Heavenly Dao, a mighty torrent of information flooding into his consciousness. It was a vision—countless Tianji Record Fragments scattered across the heavens and earth, each being tracked and recovered by some force.

And he himself stood at the center of this net.

"Fragment's host..." that cold voice spoke again, carrying a hint of amusement, "Interesting. There's actually another piece trying to break free from the chessboard's confines."

Chen Ji's divine consciousness wavered precariously under the immense pressure. He knew he only had two choices—

choice.prompt: Facing the Eye of Heavenly Dao's scrutiny, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: Conceal his aura, disguise himself as an ordinary servant, endure the pressure from Heavenly Dao, temporarily hide the existence of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May cause internal injuries from immense divine consciousness pressure
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily deceive the Eye of Heavenly Dao's tracking, buying time for subsequent plans
choices.risk_hint: If seen through, will be completely exposed, becoming Heavenly Dao's primary target for elimination

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, converging the Tianji Record's aura to its absolute limit. He pretended to be unable to withstand the pressure, his body trembling slightly, cold sweat beading on his forehead, his entire person curling up on the ground.

dialogue.content:
"Ah..." he let out a pained groan, his voice so faint it was nearly inaudible, "Heavenly Dao... have mercy..."

The performance was impeccable. A waste-of-space servant shivering under divine consciousness pressure—anyone would be convinced.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment's power to resist that scrutiny, simultaneously mobilizing all hidden trump cards, attempting to deceive the heavens under the watchful eyes of all present.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing part of one's strength may alert those with ulterior motives
choices.visible_reward: Success will bring about the Eye of Heavenly Dao's brief retreat, while leaving a deep impression on everyone present
choices.risk_hint: Failure will simultaneously offend the Eye of Heavenly Dao and the various scheming factions within the Sect's leadership

text.content: Chen Ji did not flinch. He suppressed the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to its lowest point, yet used his divine sense as a shield, forcibly resisting that scrutinizing pressure. At the same time, the corners of his mouth lifted slightly, revealing a meaningful smile.

dialogue.content: "Heh." That soft laugh rang particularly clear in the silent plaza. He raised his head, staring directly at that enormous Heavenly Secrets Eye, his eyes showing no fear at all, only a near-provocative calmness. "Junior Chen Ji greets the Heavenly Secrets Senior."

text.content: Chen Ji's two potential choices led to radically different outcomes. Regardless of which decision he made, the Heavenly Secrets Eye did not strike immediately. It simply watched him silently, the chaos within its pupil churning even more intensely, as if calculating something. After a moment, that cold voice rang out again: "Interesting." It seemed intrigued by Chen Ji's reaction—or perhaps it was waiting. Waiting for this piece to reveal more value, or waiting for an excuse to crush it utterly.

dialogue.content: Just then, a sharp sword intent suddenly rose from the crowd. Su Qingyao had somehow squeezed her way to Chen Ji's side, her hand resting on her sword's hilt, her beautiful eyes filled with wariness. Though she couldn't perceive the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pressure on Chen Ji, she sensed something deeply unusual about the atmosphere. "Chen Ji, what's wrong?" Her voice was low but carried unmistakable concern. "You look terrible." Chen Ji slightly shook his head, signaling her not to act rashly.

text.content: Su Qingyao's intuition told her that this seemingly worthless junior brother harbored an enormous secret. She noticed Chen Ji's lips moving slightly, as if silently murmuring something. Simultaneously, she felt a faint energy emanating from Chen Ji, resonating with the sacrificial tripod on the Heavenly Pivot Platform. When heavenly secrets emerge, great events must follow. This ancient saying suddenly became crystal clear in her mind. She began to understand why every attempt to probe Chen Ji had failed—perhaps this man carried secrets far more astonishing than she had imagined.

The Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil contracted slightly. It obviously detected Su Qingyao's presence and the subtle connection between her and Chen Ji. Yet it showed no concern about a human woman's interference—in its view, this was merely an inconsequential leaf added to the chessboard. However, just then, Ling Yuan's voice rang out: "Heavenly Secrets above, please grant your guidance!" The old sect master knelt on the ground with extreme reverence, yet his eyes blazed with ambition's light. He seemed intent on leveraging this heavenly manifestation to secure greater benefits.

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Secrets Eye finally shifted its gaze from Chen Ji to Ling Yuan. "Ling Yuan." That indifferent voice spoke again, but carried an almost imperceptible mockery. "So you still remember me." Ling Yuan's face changed dramatically. His knees buckled, nearly causing him to collapse. He had never expected the Heavenly Secrets Eye to recognize him—or more precisely, to recognize him as a candidate once chosen by the Tianji Record. "This old man... dares not." His voice trembled, completely losing his previous composure.

text.content: Chen Ji observed this scene intently. So that was it. Ling Yuan and the Heavenly Secrets Eye had long shared some connection. This old fox played the good person in Tianqing Sect while secretly communicating with the Heavenly Secrets. No wonder the Tianji Record had chosen Chen Ji as its inheritor back then—it had long seen through Ling Yuan's true nature. Mr. Mo's voice resonated again in his mind: "Kid, this is a rare opportunity. Ling Yuan's fox tail is showing, but he doesn't know you already know."

Chen Ji did not respond to Mr. Mo. He knew this wasn't the time to expose Ling Yuan. The Heavenly Secrets Eye still watched like a tiger eyeing its prey, and any rash move could bring catastrophic consequences. Yet he had already recorded this debt in his heart—whatever Ling Yuan owed him, he would eventually collect with interest. Simultaneously, the Heavenly Secrets Eye's gaze shifted back to Chen Ji. This time, its eyes held a more playful expression.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Heavenly Secrets Eye's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a chilling satisfaction. "I've set up countless chessboards, with pieces as numerous as sands in the Ganges. Yet one like you—" Its voice paused, "knowing you're merely a piece, yet daring to bare your claws before me, that's a first." Chen Ji felt a coldness spread from his spine throughout his entire body. He understood the Heavenly Secrets Eye was evaluating him—assessing whether he was worth 'using', or whether he should be 'eliminated' prematurely.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Secrets Eye's playful scrutiny, Chen Ji had to make another choice—

choices.description: Maintain silence, allowing the Heavenly Secrets Eye to judge while not actively exposing any trump cards, waiting for it to depart on its own.
choices.visible_cost: Endure tremendous psychological pressure; the Heavenly Secrets Eye may deepen its interest in you
choices.visible_reward: Preserve all trump cards, leaving maximum room for future scheming
choices.risk_hint: If the Heavenly Secrets Eye decides to strike now, you will have no means to fight back

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, no longer meeting the Heavenly Secrets Eye's gaze. His posture was respectful and humble, like a true ant before a god, trembling in fear. "Junior... is merely a servant disciple of the sect, daring not to offend Heavenly Secrets' majesty." His voice was calm and weak, showing no flaws.

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Secrets Eye fell silent for a moment. Its gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a long time—long enough that those around began to feel uneasy. Finally, that cold voice rang out again: "A servant? An interesting servant." It seemed to accept this explanation, yet also seemed to be merely playing a game.

choices.description: Respond to the Heavenly Secrets Eye with respectful yet subtly sharp words, demonstrating your 'value' without exposing trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: May attract further attention from the Heavenly Secrets Eye
choices.visible_reward: If successful, you may gain a breathing space, or even cause the Heavenly Secrets Eye to temporarily lower its guard
choices.risk_hint: Any wrong word could bring death

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, a faint smile curving at the corner of his mouth. His voice was calm, yet carried an unusual composure. "The Heavenly Secrets Senior speaks truly. If a chess piece harbors ambitions to overturn the heavens, that would be the greatest folly." He paused. "Unfortunately, Junior has never contemplated overturning anything."

dialogue.content: "Junior is merely a container for a fragment, seeking only to survive." His gaze was calm as still water. "If the Heavenly Secrets Senior finds Junior an eyesore, you may discard this piece at any time. Junior would bear no complaint." This speech was flawless—declaring no ambition while hinting at the existence of the Tianji Record—and portraying himself merely as a tool 'keeping' this fragment for the Heavenly Secrets.

text.content:
The Celestial Eye's pupil slightly contracted.

It had clearly detected the hidden meaning in Chen Ji's words—this chess piece was far more intelligent than anticipated. He neither denied his identity nor attempted to flee or resist. Instead, he positioned himself as a "tool," a replaceable vessel.

This attitude was both a display of weakness and a form of reconnaissance. He was observing the Celestial Eye's reaction, attempting to discern what this divine being truly desired.

dialogue.content:
The silence persisted for several more breaths.

Just as everyone expected the Celestial Eye to erupt in fury, that cold voice suddenly laughed. That laughter carried no warmth, no emotion, yet caused a bone-deep chill.

"Interesting. Most interesting."

"This One has remembered you, Chen Ji."

The moment the words fell, a thin black ray shot from the Celestial Eye's pupil. Impossibly swift, amid the gasps of the crowd, it pierced directly into Chen Ji's Brow Center.

text.content:
Chen Ji's body shuddered violently.

He felt an icy force detonate within his Mental Sea, subsequently transforming into a pitch-black seed that took root in the depths of his divine consciousness. That seed was slowly growing, emanating a nauseating pressure.

"This is... a small gift." The Celestial Eye's voice echoed in his mind. "From this day forward, This One shall constantly observe your movements. Every time you use the Tianji Record, This One will know."

Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly within his sleeves. His nails dug deep into his palms, drawing crimson blood, yet his expression remained as calm as still water.

Remembered.

Chen Ji silently recited in his heart. Every action the Celestial Eye had taken today, he recorded meticulously. Someday, he would return this "favor" a hundredfold.

Simultaneously, the Celestial Eye slowly dissipated. That massive eye above the Sacrificial Altar grew increasingly faint, eventually vanishing into nothingness. The ethereal blue glow re-engulfed the Tianxu Platform, as if everything prior had merely been an illusion.

Yet Chen Ji knew it was no illusion. That black seed now quietly resided in his divine consciousness, like an invisible eye, constantly monitoring his every action.

dialogue.content:
"Boy." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his thoughts, rarely carrying a hint of gravity. "That seed is the Celestial Eye's consciousness projection. From now on, every instance you use the Tianji Record's power will be detected by it."

Chen Ji offered no response, merely standing motionless.

"But this is also an opportunity." Mo Xiansheng shifted his tone. "Since the Celestial Eye chose to surveil you rather than directly annihilate you, it means it considers you still useful. As long as you remain sufficiently cautious, there will always be a chance for reversal.

text.content:
The ritual continued amidst the bizarre atmosphere.

Ling Yuan wiped the cold sweat from his brow and straightened himself. His gaze swept through the crowd before finally fixing upon Chen Ji. In that instant, Chen Ji sensed the murderous intent flickering in the old sect master's eyes—but swiftly, that killing intent was concealed beneath a veneer of false benevolence.

"Chen Ji." Ling Yuan's voice descended from the high platform. "Your performance earlier was commendable. Remaining unruffled in the face of heavenly might—you deserve recognition."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji bowed slightly, his demeanor reaching the pinnacle of deference.

"I thank the sect master for his praise. This disciple merely enjoyed good fortune, failing to lose composure before the heavenly might." His voice remained tranquil, betraying no dissatisfaction or sarcasm. "Had it not been for the sect master's constant guidance, this disciple would have surely fainted from terror."

These words sounded like gratitude on the surface, but in reality, they were mocking Ling Yuan—this "well-guided" sect master had actually lost his nerve before the Celestial Eye.

The surrounding elders exchanged meaningful glances, yet no one dared to speak further.

Ling Yuan's expression subtly darkened, though he swiftly regained composure.

"You speak well, child." His gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, seemingly attempting to peer through to his true thoughts. "Cultivate diligently and do not disappoint the sect's expectations for you."

Saying this, he departed, his retreating silhouette exuding an inexplicable coldness and menace.

text.content:
Chen Ji gazed at Ling Yuan's departing figure, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

Remembered. When the moment ripens, he would expose this old fox's true face before the world.

Su Qingyao had somehow approached his side, whispering, "Chen Ji, just now... what actually happened?"

Chen Ji turned to look at her, his eyes flickering with complex emotions. This woman's intuition was dangerously sharp, drawing ever closer to the truth. But at this moment, he could not yet be fully honest with her.

"Nothing." Chen Ji shook his head, a gentle smile surfacing on his face. "I've simply been targeted by the Celestial Eye."

Su Qingyao's beautiful eyes widened slightly. She detected the weight within Chen Ji's words—being marked by the Celestial Eye meant... what?

"Do you need help?" Her voice was soft yet carried undeniable resolve. "Whatever happens, I will stand by your side."

Chen Ji froze. He hadn't expected this woman, who had consistently tried to expose him, to speak such words at this moment.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then quietly asked, "Senior Sister Su, why do you trust me?"

Su Qingyao did not answer directly. She simply gazed into his eyes, saying softly, "Because of your eyes."

"My eyes?"

"Yes." Her voice carried a hint of inexplicable sentiment. "Your eyes conceal much—ambition, calculation, and... loneliness. A person with such eyes cannot possibly be a truetrash."

text.content:
Chen Ji was stunned.

He never imagined Su Qingyao would describe him with the word "loneliness." This woman, who had ceaselessly attempted to expose his secrets, turned out to be the one who came closest to the truth.

"Thank you." He spoke softly, his voice carrying a rare hint of sincerity. "If there comes a day when I can tell you everything, I certainly will."

Su Qingyao nodded without further inquiry. She understood that some matters could not be rushed.

The sacrificial ceremony finally concluded.

Three thousand six hundred disciples exhaled in relief, yet none realized that at that precise moment, the gears of Tianqing Sect's destiny had quietly begun to turn. The Celestial Eye's descent, Ling Yuan's schemes, the surveillance seed planted in Chen Ji—all the foreshadowing had been laid in that instant.

Chen Ji slowly walked toward his dwelling, the Celestial Eye's final words echoing endlessly in his mind.

"Does a chess piece wish to overturn the board?"

He raised his head, gazing at the gradually darkening sky, a profound smile forming at the corner of his lips.

Whether a chess piece wishes to overturn the board is not determined by the chess player.

Chen Ji silently recited in his heart. He slowly clenched his fist, sensing the black seed's presence in the depths of his Mental Sea. That was both a shackle and a mark—if the Celestial Eye chose to surveil him, it meant it deemed him valuable.

And being deemed valuable meant there was still a chance for reversal.

"Celestial Eye..." he murmured, his voice carrying a hint of imperceptible sharpness. "Today's gift, Chen Ji shall forever engrave in his heart. Should opportunity arise in the future, I shall repay it tenfold."

Night wind brushed past, lifting a corner of his robe. Tianqing Sect's lanterns illuminated in the distance one by one, while Chen Ji's silhouette grew increasingly solitary and profound.

This chess game had only just begun.
